text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P0: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts on hosted inference (us-west-2). Alert: error-rate > 10% over 2m, 504s spiking. Paging #oncall

sara liu: I'm on it, grabbing context. seeing a surge in queue length for priority queues on batcher-3.

mike t: saw the same on the dashboards, token throughput is steady but latency tail jumped. looks like queue head stays blocked ~30s.

raj patel: putting quick customer impact note: Hosted API global - ~8% of requests returning 5xx, top affected customers are two midmarket tenants hitting streaming endpoints. Notified account teams.

chris: can we get the batcher logs for the stuck batches? suspect long-running KV-prefetch or a stalled model worker.

emily-ng: Linking the runbook: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/queue-wedge> follow step 1-3 for live mitigation.

raj patel: paste of metrics: 
```
queue_length_priority/batcher-3 = 124 -> steady climb
batch_head_hold_time = 27s p95
gateway_5xx_rate = 12.4% (2m)
model_worker_cpu = 73% avg
kvcache_miss_rate = 0.02 -> spike at incident start
```

sara liu: I'm going to mark canary routing off to reduce pressure on batcher-3 and bias traffic to batcher-1 & 2. rolling now.

deploy-bot: Routing change initiated by sara liu: route-policy=regional-spread, target=batcher-1,batcher-2. ETA 30s.

mike t: after routing flip, queue_length_priority/batcher-3 dropping, but gateway 504s still elevated - likely backlog in downstream gateway or head-of-line in the ingress dispatcher.

chris: looking at ingress dispatcher logs: a handful of long polling requests holding KV cache locks, blocking subsequent batches. grep snippet: 
```
WARN kv-lock timeout on req=abcd1234 hold=22000ms
INFO dispatch: batch_start id=xyz hold_time=21000ms
```

emily-ng: suggestion from runbook: evict stale batches older than 20s, enable preemptive-eviction. Want me to run?

raj patel: yes do eviction on batcher-3 first, then enable preemptive-eviction globally if safe. annotate customers impacted before mass eviction.

sara liu: running eviction command on batcher-3 now: `./ctl batcher evict --host batcher-3 --age 20s --dry-run=false`

deploy-bot: Command executed by sara liu: evicted 98 batches on batcher-3. reclaiming ~1.2k tokens/s.

mike t: seeing immediate drop in queue length but a flurry of gateway 5xx as evicted requests return errors upstream. That's expected.

chris: we should enable a graceful fallback policy on the gateway to reroute to dedicated capacity for known high-QPS customers. Can infra enable overflow routing?

emily-ng: toggled overflow routing to dedicated-pool-1 for tenant IDs [A13, B42]. config: `gateway.overflow=true`

raj patel: customer impact update: errors peaked ~13% and are now down to ~4.2% after eviction + routing. those two tenants have a small fraction of traffic but were amplifying head-of-line effects.

sara liu: next step—investigate cause of KV lock holds. if it's a model worker GC loop or a blocking I/O. grabbing worker logs for the 30s window.

mike t: also worth checking recent deploys. any rollout to batcher-3 in last hour?

deploy-bot: Recent deploys: `inference-runtime v2.14.1` rolled to batcher-3 at 1759996200 by ci-cd. No rollbacks yet.

chris: ok, v2.14.1 had a change to KV prefetch concurrency default (10 -> 5). could cause stalls if under-provisioned for priority workloads.

emily-ng: temporary mitigation: bump prefetch concurrency on batcher-3 to 8, and increase dispatcher threads by +2. applying now.

sara liu: applied config, restarting dispatcher on batcher-3 with zero-downtime handoff.

raj patel: metrics post-change: queue head hold p95 down to 7s, queue_length_priority=12, gateway 5xx down to 1.8%. great.

mike t: can we keep overflow routing for 10m and monitor? will coordinate with account owners for customer notification.

chris: we should revert this region's deploy of v2.14.1 to batcher-2/3 if we see recurrence. for now, escalate to runtime team to run a targeted repro on v2.14.1 kv prefetch path.

sara liu: handing off on-call to mike t — I've been on for 40m, tired and want continuity. Handoff note: eviction done, prefetch bump & dispatcher threads increased, overflow routing enabled for tenants A13/B42, monitoring in place.

mike t: taking over. I'll keep this open for 45m and then demote to follow-up ticket. tagging runtime team: @chris @raj for postmortem.

emily-ng: runbook step follow-up: open incident ticket and capture exact commands and timestamps. I'll create the incident doc and add a short customer-facing blurb.

raj patel: created INC-2026-0421 in tracker with timeline and mitigations. linking: <https://redwood-issues/INC-2026-0421>.

mike t: closing note for immediate thread: service stabilized, error-rate reduced to baseline, remaining action items: (1) runtime repro for kv prefetch lock, (2) consider rolling rollback for v2.14.1 to batcher pool if repro confirms.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as P0 -> transitioned to P1 monitoring at 1759999120.

mike t: thanks all. I'll keep the incident doc updated and coordinate the postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
